title: Paccantam
text: 2. Atha kho Bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyam paṃsum āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi || || 3. Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave || katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yo vāyam mayā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito ayaṃ vā mahāpathavī ti || || Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yad idam mahāpathavī || appamattako yam Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito saṅkham pi na upeti upanidham pi na upeti kalabhāgam pi na upeti || mahāpathavim upanidhāya Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito ti || || 4. Evam eva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāyanti || atha kho ete va bahutarā sattā ye paccantimesu janapadesu paccājāyanti || aviññātāresu milakkhesu || pa pe || || [page 467] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 467
